notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the standard ownership acquisition-cancellation transfer boundary. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador ownership APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. Evoked delivery verifies cancellation completion against a concurrent Divestiture If Wanted transfer; immediate delivery verifies the same standard transfer through a deterministic pending acquisition. Both paths check ownership state, callback tags, and cleanup without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador attributeOwnershipAcquisition, cancelAttributeOwnershipAcquisition, and attributeOwnershipDivestitureIfWanted with standard ownership callbacks
